claims: Entry context begins with higher-timeframe environment and resistance; the right shoulder is not a stand-alone signal.
Wait for a W-top or head-and-shoulders right-shoulder formation area.
Reverse FR 38.2 is used as a guide for a prospective right-shoulder area, with bearish candle confirmation in the foundational example.
For the W-top example, the left shoulder is the stop anchor.
A formation can exist inside the right shoulder of a larger formation.
The right shoulder of a W-top can itself be a W-top or head-and-shoulders; the same nested idea applies to a head-and-shoulders right shoulder.
The nested structure is treated as a repeated market pattern, not an isolated visual coincidence.
An M5 example is described as a W-top right-shoulder head-and-shoulders structure.
FR interaction and rejection are used together with the nested formation before short entry.
Multiple M5 examples treat FR 38.2 interaction, support/resistance confluence and candle rejection as context for deciding that a right shoulder is forming.
The examples show that the exact visual route into the right shoulder varies; Fibonacci remains a guide rather than a universal stand-alone trigger.
Parent and mini formations can be interpreted together at the right shoulder.
The author notes that using roughly the time spent forming the left shoulder for the right shoulder gives better visual balance, while also noting that waiting can cause a missed entry.
The author allows equivalent right-shoulder readings such as W-top versus head-and-shoulders when the stop location is unchanged.
The repeated instruction is to enter at some form of formation right shoulder rather than chasing the first reversal move.
Formation shape alone is insufficient; MA, zone and higher-timeframe context remain necessary.
The same apparent formation can be a no-trade when the surrounding context is not aligned.
The official material specifically teaches the procedure around a W-top / head-and-shoulders right shoulder.
It reiterates that higher-timeframe environment recognition is more important than the isolated entry logic.
Official master course ④ lists W-formation importance and right-shoulder interpretation as core learning topics.

negative_evidence.finding: Primary official material located so far confirms MA25-5 as a Poconical component, but no machine-safe primary definition was found for the phrase 'inside DMA25x5' in terms of candle part, bar count or distance tolerance.
negative_evidence.policy: Do not infer the definition from third-party notes or user-community summaries. Keep manual/research-only.
